measurement.question: Does a fixed generated input produce byte-stable output within each source arm on gfx90a?
measurement.environment_policy: Child gets a fresh allowlisted environment with no inherited GGML_* variables; only GGML_CUDA_FA_MASK_SKIP=0 is set.
measurement.qualification_mode: FILLER_DRYRUN=1 or KVU_GPU_QUALIFICATION=1 executes case78 once per arm on GPU. Producer selects exactly four CPUs from actual grant intersect inherited affinity and restricts its own affinity; child inherits. Fresh attempt directory on every retry; failure returns1 without requested native success file. Full uses eight CPUs.
measurement.stop_on_answer: first differing raw-output SHA-256 stops further repeats for that case/arm; preserve partial record
measurement.matching_five_means: no mismatch observed in five runs for that case/arm only

unsupported_case_policy: Refuse the run if stdout does not contain exactly one supported record for the requested case ID, if it reports unsupported, or if the raw output is missing, empty, or has a byte count different from expected_raw_output_bytes.
decision_rule: For every attempted run require source and artifact digest checks, exactly one supported case-id stdout record, exact raw output byte count, SHA-256, mapped expected libggml-hip DSO, and at least one positive own-PID MI210 KFD VRAM sample collected while the child is alive. A source mismatch, runtime proof failure, child failure, missing/unsupported case, missing/wrong-size output, STOP or deadline is inconclusive and preserves partial evidence. First output mismatch answers that arm/case as observed variable and stops that arm/case; five matching outputs are not proof of absence.
provenance_limit: capture-build row is filed inconclusive because its qualification compilation does not satisfy the declared full-build rule; its source-bound preserved executable is used as an input artifact only. The row must retain that limitation.

frozen_packet.scope: launcher verifies source manifest and all runtime content before producer; same-UID mutation remains a custody limitation

publication_declaration: Static predeclaration only; readiness and actual publication are external rowflow state, never claimed by this spec.
